_about: Overhead protection prayer per target, first matching rule wins: checked Wiki strategy pages (page), then each other monster's Wiki attack styles. names match a name or its versions, prefix: a name start. A rule without a note lists a form with no advice. melee is the advice for a melee setup, which stands in melee range. Static reference only, never a live switching cue.

rules.note: Keep Protect from Magic active before Vorkath attacks; do not reactively switch between his ordinary projectiles. Without a ranged setup's fire shield, Magic also supplies part of your dragonfire protection. Use super antifire; regular antifire with a fire shield leaves more chip damage. Re-enable the overhead after the purple breath disables it, and dodge the fireball and acid specials.

melee.note: Keep Protect from Magic active before Vorkath attacks; do not reactively switch between his ordinary projectiles. Melee setups use Magic and rely on armour's ranged defence. Stay in melee range between specials; stepping back increases the frequency of ranged attacks. Use super antifire; regular antifire with a fire shield leaves more chip damage. Re-enable the overhead after the purple breath disables it, and dodge the fireball and acid specials.

rules.note: Keep Magic with a shieldless / two-handed setup or when fighting away from KBD. A fire shield and adjacent position allow Melee once unlocked. Use antifire; special breaths can still deal chip damage. Normal breath timing doesn't allow reactive style switches.
Prayers are disabled in Barbarian Assault. Use armour, healing and the encounter's role mechanics instead of an overhead.
This champion's challenge disallows Prayer; protection overheads cannot be used.
Stay outside melee range. Switch to Magic for raised legs and Missiles for the stomp before the delayed hit; melee has no reaction window.

melee.note: Keep Melee between attacks: his melee has no warning. Switch to Magic or Missiles from the raised-legs / stomp animation, then return to Melee.

rules.note: Read each attack animation: claws mean Melee, pink petals mean Magic, and the contortion means Missiles. React during the wind-up. Melee threatens the tank and nearby players. The curse remaps prayer buttons; Phosani P3 disables correct prayers at attack start, so reactivate during the wind-up.

Read each attack animation: claws mean Melee, pink petals mean Magic, and the contortion means Missiles. React during the wind-up. Melee threatens the tank and nearby players. The curse remaps prayer buttons; Phosani P3 disables correct prayers at attack start, so reactivate during the wind-up.

Keep Melee against tail swipes while adjacent. Switch to Magic for electricity and Missiles for flying fur before their projectiles hit; dodge falling bricks. All setups must follow the fight's attacks.
Pray before projectile impact: blue Magic, green Missiles, orange Melee. Melee orbs reach you at distance too. Dodge boulders and special attacks; don't use armour to choose a fixed overhead.
Switch Magic / Missiles to match each volley before impact, including mixed volleys later in the fight. Freeze her after specials to prevent melee; dodge tentacles and use the special's safe areas.

Pray before impact: blue Magic, green Missiles, red Melee. Melee projectiles occur from delve 2 and can reach you at distance. Restore the overhead after rock explosions disable it; dodge debris and specials. Standing next to Doom also exposes you to a prayer-piercing tongue attack.

melee.note: Pray before impact: blue Magic, green Missiles, red Melee. Melee projectiles occur from delve 2 and can reach you at distance. Restore the overhead after rock explosions disable it; dodge debris and specials. Standing next to Doom also exposes you to a prayer-piercing tongue attack.

rules.note: Pray before impact: blue Magic, green Missiles, red Melee. Melee projectiles occur from delve 2 and can reach you at distance. Restore the overhead after rock explosions disable it; dodge debris and specials. Standing next to Doom also exposes you to a prayer-piercing tongue attack.
Follow Yama's ranged / magic attack cues, switching to the matching overhead. Stay outside melee range and dodge shadow crashes / waves; P3 can still chip through prayer.

melee.note: Follow Yama's attack cues and current ranged / magic cycle; use Melee for his close-range attack. Protection reduces rather than eliminates all damage, especially in P3. Dodge specials.

rules.note: Count three ordinary attacks of each style, then switch Magic / Missiles before the next attack. Specials don't count. In the extinguished phase alternate after every ordinary attack. The first style is random; don't wait for ordinary projectiles to land.

Keep Missiles for the initial ranged cycle; switch after each four boss attacks using the style-change cue. Keep the correct prayer active when the attack launches, not at impact. Reactivate prayers after the disabling attack; dodge floor hazards and tornadoes.

Keep Magic for ordinary attacks; their prayer is checked at launch. Her predictable triple attack is Magic, Missiles, Melee. For summoned souls, read the left-to-right colours and activate each matching prayer before that ghost attacks. This is not reactive switching for random ordinary attacks.

Keep the prayer matching its current style. It changes style after three unsuccessful attacks; prepare for the next style before it attacks. Melee may be unannounced, including when it approaches a ranged setup. Dodge falling rocks.

Keep the prayer matching the demon's current attack style. It changes attack style after its fire-bomb special; dodge the bombs and read the next style cue. It can approach to melee regardless of your weapon. Its own protection prayer is a separate mechanic.

Read the charged orb order and activate each matching prayer BEFORE its projectile launches, one tick apart. Standard order is Magic / Missiles or Missiles / Magic, then Melee; the melee orb reaches you at distance. Mantimayhem can change the pattern. Don't react to mid-flight orbs.

The blob reads your overhead three ticks before its attack and chooses the counter style. Change to the matching prayer before projectile launch; don't camp one overhead. In melee range it can also melee, so keep space while solving the wave.
No overhead blocks the teleport / lightning hazards; move to safety. Resume the appropriate form's prayer when ordinary attacks restart.
Use Melee during the melee form, even with a ranged weapon: it approaches you. Freeze / kite or step back before it attacks to prevent prayer-piercing damage; switch when the form changes.

Keep Missiles for ordinary ranged attacks, checked at animation start. Switch to Magic immediately on the charged purple-orb wind-up, BEFORE launch, then return to Missiles. Switch to Melee for melee form; the prayer-shield phase also needs prayer-draining attacks.

Keep Melee while in melee range, including the enraged phase. Outside melee range he uses Magic / Missiles against your weaker defence and approaches you; return to Melee when he reaches you. Acid, cleaves and araxytes require movement.

At distance follow the spider's current Magic / Missiles attack cycle; change before the next attack. If adjacent, use Melee. Kill spiderlings and avoid the web; don't assume every ordinary projectile can be reacted to mid-flight.

melee.note: Keep Melee while next to the spider. At distance follow its ranged / magic attack cycle, changing before the next attack. Kill spiderlings to restore prayer effectiveness and avoid the prayer-draining web.

rules.note: Follow the visible current attack form, not the projectile's appearance. The balance elemental gives a short reaction window (shorter below half health); all three protection prayers may be needed as forms change.

Follow the visible current attack form, not the projectile's appearance. The balance elemental gives a short reaction window (shorter below half health); all three protection prayers may be needed as forms change.

Follow the visible current attack form, not the projectile's appearance. The balance elemental gives a short reaction window (shorter below half health); all three protection prayers may be needed as forms change.

Pray by phase and who Nex targets: Magic for smoke / blood / ice, Missiles for shadow, and Melee when tanking close-range attacks or the final phase. Kiting and melee distancing change which attacks you receive. Her attacks pierce prayers; don't switch reactively against every random projectile.

Start with Missiles; switch Magic / Missiles by the post-screech phase. Turn OFF overheads during the white-aura screech or it damages you repeatedly. Later, dodge the melee slams or use Melee to reduce their damage. Don't choose a fixed prayer from the merged infobox max hits.
Use Magic in the fire phase and Missiles from the air phase onward. Change by phase rather than reacting to ordinary projectiles. Use a fire shield plus antifire and dodge the lethal specials.
Use Magic in the fire phase and Missiles from the air phase onward. Change by phase rather than reacting to ordinary projectiles. Use a fire shield plus antifire and dodge the lethal specials.

melee.note: The tank-armour melee method keeps Magic throughout the fight. Use a fire shield plus antifire, restore prayer after pink breath, and dodge fireballs, traps, waves and rock tombs.

rules.note: Keep Melee against the Mimic even while using ranged or magic. Move away from thrown sweets and keep attacking the boss; its summoned minions are separate attackers.
Use the early-phase safespots; overheads don't block his second-phase ranged damage. In the final phase use Melee when close and Magic at distance, with movement to manage his push / pull attacks.

melee.note: Use the early-phase safespots; overheads don't block his second-phase ranged damage. In the final phase use Melee when close and Magic at distance, with movement to manage his push / pull attacks.

rules.note: Keep Melee and equip a tortugan shield: without it, melee hits pierce protection prayer. Occasional ranged hits remain; dodge corrosive spit, whirlwind and knockback specials.

For minimum damage, match each feather's colour with Magic, Missiles or Melee before impact, including while attacking body or tail. In teams, an assigned pillar prayer may take priority to maintain the damage buff. Dodge lightning and tail shockwaves.
Magma form's directed attacks aren't blocked by overheads; move after it targets your tile. Resume the appropriate prayer when the next form appears.
Keep Magic in tanzanite form; random ranged attacks cannot reliably be prayer-switched reactively. Read the rotation and change overhead before the next form's attack.

Keep Missiles in ordinary serpentine phases. In the rotation's Jad phase, alternate Magic / Missiles BEFORE each launch according to the known rotation; do not wait for impact. The infobox form alone doesn't identify Jad phase.

Use Melee while she is next to you and Missiles when her web separates you. Change before the next attack, not in reaction to an ordinary projectile. Aranea boots prevent the web and can remove the need for this switch; magic spawns are separate attackers.

melee.note: Use Melee while she is next to you and Missiles when her web separates you. Change before the next attack, not in reaction to an ordinary projectile. Aranea boots prevent the web and can remove the need for this switch; magic spawns are separate attackers.

rules.note: Keep Missiles while freezing and keeping the bear away; use Melee if it reaches you (melee pierces prayer). Switch to Magic for the visible knockback orb before impact, then return to the ordinary attack prayer. Avoid traps.

melee.note: Keep Missiles while freezing and keeping the bear away; use Melee if it reaches you (melee pierces prayer). Switch to Magic for the visible knockback orb before impact, then return to the ordinary attack prayer. Avoid traps.

rules.note: Keep Melee for Vardorvis; switch to Missiles for the head's green projectile before it hits, then return to Melee. Dodge axes; missed head attacks disable protection prayers.
Use Melee for the summoned skeletal hellhounds. The boss's lightning and shield bash must be dodged; this overhead does not block those attacks.
No overhead blocks Kephri's ground-targeted fireballs: step away from the shadow. Eggs and dung also require movement. Use the matching overhead for any attacking scarab bodyguard instead.

Only use Melee for the timed triple parry, activating it just before each spear hit. Praying early makes Sol disable it. His ordinary spear / shield AoE is typeless and must be dodged; an overhead is not needed for those attacks.
Overheads don't protect against Zalcano's hazards; dodge rockfalls, avoid red symbols and move away from explosive rocks.
Keep Magic; it only reduces his magic damage, rather than fully blocking it. Avoid melee and stomp range; move away from the dark core.
Keep Magic. The ordinary projectile's damage style cannot be identified visually, so reactive switching is not possible.

Keep Magic in both forms. Magic and ranged attacks bypass the usual accuracy roll, so armour alone cannot make them miss; Missiles is a similar alternative in solo fights. Her own overheads indicate defensive bonuses, not your prayer choice.
Keep Magic; tank ordinary melee with armour or keep out of melee reach. A mirror / V's shield is still required.
Keep Missiles against Kree'arra's main attack. His ranged-magic attack deals magic damage despite its ranged accuracy; normal armour accuracy estimates do not describe all of his attack mechanics.
Keep Missiles while safely kiting / freezing Graardor. If he reaches you, use Melee. Minions remain separate attackers; this assumes the movement method keeps his melee out of reach.

melee.note: Keep Melee while tanking Graardor. Armour covers ranged hits; non-tanks in teams generally use Missiles. Minions are separate attackers and require different priorities after the boss dies.

rules.note: While safely kiting Zilyana, ranged setups use Magic and magic setups use Missiles to cover the more dangerous minion for that armour. Zilyana herself only attacks when she reaches melee distance; don't stand still to tank her rapid attacks.

melee.note: While safely kiting Zilyana, ranged setups use Magic and magic setups use Missiles to cover the more dangerous minion for that armour. Zilyana herself only attacks when she reaches melee distance; don't stand still to tank her rapid attacks.

rules.note: Use Missiles when safely binding / kiting K'ril to cover the ranged minion. The boss only attacks in melee distance; switch to Melee if reached. Bodyguard damage and team roles affect the choice.

melee.note: Solo / conventional melee tanks keep Melee, but it can trigger his prayer-smash special. A team tank in high melee-defence armour can use Magic instead. Restore prayer after smashes.

rules.note: Keep Magic if fighting outside melee reach; Duke uses magic there. His intended melee method uses Melee and pillar movement. Specials require movement.

melee.note: Keep Melee and step behind the pillar after each attack to avoid the slam. Prayer only reduces slam damage; dodge gaze, icicles and gas.

rules.note: Keep Missiles against Dawn and avoid falling debris / her freezing projectile. Switch to Melee when moving to Dusk.
Keep Melee while attacking Dusk up close; in his final form use Missiles if separated from him, then return to Melee when adjacent. Dodge specials.
Keep Melee while attacking Dusk up close; in his final form use Missiles if separated from him, then return to Melee when adjacent. Dodge specials.

melee.note: Keep Melee while attacking Dusk up close; in his final form use Missiles if separated from him, then return to Melee when adjacent. Dodge specials.

rules.note: Keep Missiles for the usual melee or snare-and-magic method. It reduces rather than completely blocks his ranged damage; keep food and maintain distance when snaring.
Keep Melee against the titans' stomp, including the arena-wide stomp in the later phase. When only one titan remains it can pierce prayer. Spells and elementals require movement / target changes.
Keep Magic and restore it during the wind-up after her prayer-disabling attack. It mitigates the initial spikes / icicle, but persistent pools require movement.
Tekton only attacks with melee.
Keep Protect from Missiles active: it makes the ice demon use snowballs rather than Ice Burst and reduces their damage. Step away from the targeted tiles.
Shamans spit ranged attacks; they also melee adjacent players. Their jump and purple spawns aren't prayable: move away.
Use Melee against the melee Vanguard, which can approach you. Keep other Vanguards out of range where possible.
Use Missiles against the ranged Vanguard. Prayer reduces its projectile damage and accuracy; move away from the other targeted tiles.
Use Magic against the magic Vanguard. Prayer reduces its projectile damage and accuracy; move away from the other targeted tiles.
Vespula's stings are ranged.
Vespula keeps stinging with ranged while you attack the portal.
Usually none: step out of the slam. Its slam is melee, so use Protect from Melee only if you tank it.
Use Missiles for Vasa's boulders and dodge their targeted area. Use Magic when joining the stunned players during his teleport special; stunned players cannot pray.
The crystal doesn't attack.
Mystics cast magic at range and also melee adjacent players; fight them from distance.
At distance the small muttadile uses ranged.

melee.note: The small muttadile bites in melee range.

rules.note: Keep Protect from Missiles at distance: the large muttadile's ranged attacks hit harder and more accurately than its magic. Stay out of melee and stomp range.

melee.note: The large muttadile bites hard in melee range; step back and it uses ranged and magic.

rules.note: Deathly rangers use ranged.
Deathly mages use magic.

Maintain the prayer for Olm's head's current style, updating it for subsequent attacks after a style change; ordinary attacks aren't reliably telegraphed. His coloured spheres can be prayed against before impact. The head keeps attacking while you damage either hand.
Boulders don't attack: one that rolls into you deals heavy damage and knocks you back, and overhead prayers don't block it. Ba-Ba stops attacking while she throws them.
Ba-Ba's attacks are melee; dodge her boulders and falling rocks.

The shadow doesn't make ordinary attacks; Akkha keeps attacking while you damage it. Match Akkha's current form with Melee, Missiles or Magic before he attacks; he can approach ranged and magic setups too.

Akkha cycles melee, ranged and magic forms: maintain the matching prayer before he attacks, using his form / overhead as the cue. He can approach ranged and magic setups. Perfect butterfly kiting avoids melee; an ordinary ranged setup doesn't guarantee that.
Zebak alternates ranged and magic rocks: pray against each. He bites players next to him.

melee.note: Zebak can't be tanked in melee range; step back between his ranged and magic rocks.

rules.note: P1 charged orbs and energy trough damage aren't blocked by overhead prayers. Desynchronise the Wardens, share / separate for the appropriate orb and heal; avoid UFOs.
The core doesn't attack.
Dodge the Warden's floor attacks. Match the supporting Akkha / Zebak echo's Magic or Missiles attacks; prayer does not block the Warden's floor damage.
The Warden alternates magic and ranged projectiles: pray against each. Dodge its slam.
P2: match the Warden's Magic / Missiles projectiles and keep out of melee reach; Tumeken's Warden can approach you. Dodge obelisk beams and floor attacks.

melee.note: P2: use Melee between projectile attacks if Tumeken's Warden reaches you; match its Magic / Missiles projectiles. Dodge obelisk beams and floor attacks.

rules.note: Maiden's blood attacks are magic.
The nylocas don't attack; keep Protect from Magic against Maiden.
None: step out from under Bloat before it stomps and dodge the falling flesh.
Vasilias attacks with its current form's style and changes form every few attacks.
Vasilias attacks with its current form's style and changes form every few attacks.
Vasilias attacks with its current form's style and changes form every few attacks.
Sotetseg alternates magic and ranged orbs: pray against each.

melee.note: Tanking in melee range: Protect from Melee against its melee, switching to Magic or Missiles for its magic and ranged orbs.

rules.note: None needed: Xarpus's spit is typeless, so no overhead reduces it (Protect from Missiles is only habit). Avoid the acid pools.
Hide behind a pillar; her P1 attack is magic.
Keep Protect from Missiles during Verzik P2. Step off the urn bomb tiles and step back between melee attacks to avoid her slam.
Verzik P3 rotates magic and ranged at distance; every fifth attack is a special.

melee.note: Pray against her magic and ranged attacks. Her melee is typeless and no prayer blocks it: stay out of her melee range unless you are tanking. Every fifth attack is a special.

rules.note: No overhead blocks the teleport / lightning hazards; move to safety. Resume the appropriate form's prayer when ordinary attacks restart.
Use Melee during the melee form, even with a ranged weapon: it approaches you. Freeze / kite or step back before it attacks to prevent prayer-piercing damage; switch when the form changes.

Keep Missiles for ordinary ranged attacks, checked at animation start. Switch to Magic immediately on the charged purple-orb wind-up, BEFORE launch, then return to Missiles. Switch to Melee for melee form; the prayer-shield phase also needs prayer-draining attacks.
Keep Missiles against the ranged spit; stay clear of melee, jumps and purple spawns. Shayzien armour and poison protection are separate requirements.
